title: UDP Multicast Receive
text: Receive data over UDP network from a remote device, 2 outputs, {Group address} sets Multicast group to join; {Bind address} sets the bind IP address for receiving multicast data, {Local port} sets the destination UDP port to receive data, {Receive width} sets the width of Data output vector, {Group interface} sets the local IP interface from which to receive and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the sample time of block. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Bind address
params.values: Bind IP address for receiving multicast data 0.0.0.0 (default)

params.name: Local port
params.values: Destination UDP port to receive data 1–65535

params.name: Group address
params.values: Multicast group to join {} (default) | {’x.x.x.x’} | dotted decimal character vector

params.name: Group interface
params.values: Local IP interface from which to receive data {} (default) | {’x.x.x.x’} | dotted decimal character vector
